en: An old German postcard with a sepia photograph in the upper left showing a large hilltop fortress or castle complex above a town or river. The card is divided into three sections: the left side contains handwritten cursive text, the middle top bears the printed word "Postkarte" framed by a decorative border, and the upper right has a German stamp featuring an imperial eagle and circular postmark. The address on the right is written to a recipient in Heidelberg. The overall style is late 19th or early 20th century.
